annotations.title: Show print templates to choose from

description: Start here when a user asks for something to be made, designed or printed and has not supplied a finished design: business cards, flyers, postcards, posters, brochures, menus, invitations, stationery, tickets. It finds ready-made, editable templates from Designprint's template library. Pass the product and a few words on what it is for. It returns templates of that product's size, each with its title, a picture of every side and the texts it holds. Show the pictures to the user and ask which they like; then call open_template to open the one they pick in the Designprint editor with their own details on it. Nothing is made or charged by this call.

about.description: What it is for, in a few plain words, for example "yoga class", "pizza restaurant", "real estate agent". Leave out to see general templates.

page.description: 2, 3 and so on for more templates of the same search.

product.description: What is being printed. One of: business-cards, postcards, flyers, posters, brochures, menus, invitations-and-cards, stationery, more. "more" is tickets and coupons.

size.description: A size key from an earlier result's `sizes`. Leave out for the product's usual size.
